Our Roofing Services

Pitched and flat roofing, roof windows, roofline, coatings and emergency repairs for homes and businesses across Lancashire and the Fylde coast.

Pitched Roofs and Re-RoofsNatural slate, man-made slate and tiled roofs, installed and replaced. Flat RoofingSingle-ply and EPDM rubber, built as warm or cold roofs. Commercial Roofing and CoatingsFlat roof systems, repairs, inspections and roof coatings. Roof WindowsVelux windows fitted into tile and slate roofs. UPVC RooflineFascias, soffits and guttering in uPVC. Emergency RepairsSlipped tiles, storm damage and leaks.
InsulationOffered alongside roofing work. Ask us when we quote.
Solar PanelsOffered alongside roofing work. Ask us when we quote.
